touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Corris qualifies as a local detour through Corris Railway Museum and Corris Craft Centre. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Corris: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Corris Railway Museum
